subject: Minor cleanup to update cluster-node-timeout config name references (#4488)
reason: The change only edits human-readable text: a log message string in valkey-cli's clusterManagerCommandSetTimeout error path (renaming 'node-timeout' to 'cluster-node-timeout' in the message) and comments/example numbers in valkey.conf.
